question.question:
A fictional merchant's card processor bills monthly. Gross card volume this month is 55000 USD. Variable fees are marginal: 3 percent on the first 46000 USD of gross volume and 1.9 percent on any gross volume above that breakpoint. Refunds of 2500 USD in the same month earn a fee credit equal to refunded volume times the blended rate, where the blended rate is the gross variable fee divided by gross volume. Refunds also incur a surcharge of 0.35 percent of refunded volume, which is never credited. A loyalty rebate of 10 percent applies to the net variable fee (gross variable fee minus refund credit, excluding the surcharge) and is capped at 250 USD per month. The net monthly fee equals gross variable fee minus refund credit plus surcharge minus rebate. What is the net monthly fee in USD?

Answer format: use exact arithmetic through all intermediate steps, round only the final value half up to 2 decimal digits, and return only the numeric value interpreted in `usd` with no unit label or additional text.

slots.description: Gross variable fee from both marginal tiers before refunds.
Fee credit returned on refunded volume at the blended rate.
Loyalty rebate actually applied after the monthly cap.
